record.kind: kill hook hard-coded in PokemonEntity.onKill (no PassiveEffects entry)
record.summary: Passive.MOXIE has no PassiveEffects entry; it is hard-coded in PokemonEntity.onKill (app/core/pokemon-entity.ts). When any unit kills another (PokemonState.triggerDeath calls attacker.onKill if the attacker is not the dying unit), every unit currently on a board cell with passive MOXIE and the same team as the killer (killer = this) calls addAttack(target.stars, v, 0, false), where target is the unit that died and v is the MOXIE holder itself. The killer need not be the holder, may be a summoned or spawned unit (the code comment says spawn is included), and may be on either side, so a MOXIE unit on the enemy team also reacts to kills by its own team. The requested amount is the killed unit's star count (1, 2 or 3 for ordinary units); the applied change is Math.round of that value, then Big Eater Belt on the holder (x1.25 rounded down to an integer), Twist Band (no effect on positive), with atk kept at least 1; there is no AP or crit scaling. The gain is stored in the combat entity's atk only (permanent is false), so it ends with the fight. A kill that is prevented by resurrection status never reaches triggerDeath, so it gives no attack. The BLOOD_MONEY rule and killCount in the same function are separate effects.
triggers: PokemonEntity.onKill of any unit after it kills an opponent (from PokemonState.triggerDeath)
